'''Dommu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Dommu owned a shop in the [[Senate Commercial District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he sold item modifications and upgrades.

==Behind the scenes==
Dommu appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Mods Vendor for Republic players on Coruscant.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Dommu was removed from the game along with the rest of the Mods Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
